claims.text: It is the sensor-side counterpart to the cloaking and signature-reduction strand of the survey: Puthoff described the DIA Broad Area Announcement as specifying twelve threat areas including 'lift, propulsion, signature reduction, human effects and so on.'
Puthoff named 'IEC fusion as a compact energy source' among the studies he commissioned, in his June 2018 Society for Scientific Exploration account of letting 38 contracts over a two-year period.
Puthoff, describing the commission at the June 2018 Society for Scientific Exploration conference, named 'invisibility cloaking' among the papers he let contracts for.

edges.label: commissioned under AAWSAP; lowest DIA document number in the released set
edges.note: Tier 2, and the reason is worth stating. A full-text scan of this released DIRD on 23 August 2026 found NO occurrence of the programme name anywhere in the document - unlike 27 of the 32 scanned, whose inside cover names the Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications Program explicitly. The link therefore rests on the DIA's 9 January 2018 list to the Senate Armed Services Committee, which enumerates it among the 38 reference products, and not on the document's own text.

edges.label: produced at EarthTech International, Austin
edges.note: EarthTech, run by Hal Puthoff, was the largest single source of DIRDs, producing six of the 38. Puthoff has stated that BAASS 'connected me at EarthTech International to collaborate as a subcontractor' and that he then let the 38 contracts himself. The arrangement means EarthTech occupied both sides of the transaction on this document: commissioning agent and author's employer.

edges.label: subject domain: transformation optics, metamaterials and signature reduction
edges.note: Contents run Camouflage, Transparency, Cloaking. The paper is the signature-reduction leg of the survey, sitting alongside Shvets's 'Metamaterials for Aerospace Applications' and against Culbreth's hypersonic detection paper. Puthoff listed signature reduction among the twelve threat areas DIA specified in the Broad Area Announcement.
